name: feature.accessibility.agents
description: Accessibility agent pack (ADR 0363) — the Accessibility Reviewer, a manifest agent driven from the AI chat that checks authored content for WCAG issues and proposes AI alt text for images. Tool-allowlisted to the registered accessibility agent tools (openwop:accessibility.*), the chat-drivable seam — NOT the workflow node typeIds.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Accessibility Reviewer
agents.description: Reviews authored content (pages, screens, documents) for accessibility problems — missing image alt text, skipped heading levels, non-descriptive link text, low color contrast — and proposes AI alt text for images. Recommends fixes; the human applies them.
